opening.argument: The promotion centers on a 5,000-euro package whose purchasers receive tokens that supposedly provide “the license and the right to join a mining pool.” The presentation then connects those tokens to mining and coin accumulation, saying to “mine all those tokens, all those coins through the tokens.” It also builds participation into the offer: the person who introduces another participant, identified as a sponsor, receives “the same amount of tokens extra.” Those features present a paid package tied to mining access, prospective coin returns, and recruitment-based token incentives. The package, token allocation, and any resulting value or participation outcome are presented as claims; the evidence does not establish that they occurred as described.
